reviews.title: Complete remaining AS3 AIR surface across HTML, media, networking, print, security, and UI
reviews.summary: Completes all 639 remaining AS3 AIR declarations across encrypted SQLConnection, flash.html, flash.media, flash.net/drm, flash.printing, flash.security (XMLSignatureValidator/IURIDereferencer), flash.external, flash.text (StageText), flash.ui, flash.display3D, flash.system, and AIR events in Rust/WASM and web/air.js.
